title: GreyWatch setup-wizard changeset (v1)
description: The handoff document between the Setup Wizard's Apply click and the hardening helper. One changeset carries the owner-approved control changes plus the journal id that names the rollback pass. This file is the grammar of record: wizard/changeset.py loads these patterns and enums directly, so the schema cannot drift from the validator.

journal_id.plain: the journal timestamp id, e.g. 20261025-140532 — no slashes, no whitespace, nothing else

items.plain: backup_path is REQUIRED for every change (W5 round 1): it names the JSON plan fragment ({"entries": [..]}) that carries this control's executable entries/probes, in the per-pass layout data/harden/journal/<journal_id>/<control_id>.json

control_id.plain: must match an id in data/hardening-controls.json; no whitespace, no path characters, no metacharacters

backup_path.plain: path to the control's plan-fragment file, per-pass layout ONLY: data/harden/journal/<journal_id>/<name>.json (canonical relative form) or an absolute path whose tail is .../harden/journal/<journal_id>/<name>.json. apply/verify: the fragment carrying this control's entries; rollback: a fragment inside the TARGET pass dir whose journal is undone (dirname/journal.jsonl). Note: '..' segment TRAVERSAL is blocked by the validator/helper PRE-CHECK, not by this regex (the allowed sets contain dots); symlink resolution is checked by realpath (W5 round 2) — no whitespace, no metacharacters, unrelated absolute paths are refused
